{{Top|leg}}
'''Audio discs''' were a form of data storage medium used to store sound and music. [[The Matrix]], an industrial sound system used at the [[Glow Dome]], was capable of playing audio discs alongside [[sound slug]]s and live bands.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
